Looks like multiples to me. Taking the second example:

You'll need "bar" for the data across the bottom. "line" for your two colored lines, and I think "pointrange" for the data in the middle. Or are those boxplots? 

You can't have multiple scales for one axis though so, you'll have to use grid to put two different plots with different axes stacked on top of each other. Similar in style to your first example. 

If you make a reproducible example the people on this list can start putting the pieces together with you. 

B

# here's what I got for an attempt at OHLC & candlestick charts

# grab data
require(quantmod)
getSymbols(c('SPY'), src="yahoo")
SPYlag = lag(SPY,1)
SPY<-SPY['2011-09-01::']
SPYlag<-SPYlag['2011-09-01::']

df =data.frame(SPY)
df$date=as.Date(rownames(df))

# try open/high/low/close with linerange plus points
ggplot(data=df,aes(x=date, y=SPY.Close, ymin=SPY.Low, ymax=SPY.High))
+ opts(title="S&P") + ylab("S&P") + theme_bw() + geom_linerange() +
geom_point(aes(shape=95)) + geom_point(aes(y=SPY.Open, shape=95))

# the problem with this OHLC is the open tick mark should be to the
left of the line, the close tick mark should be to the right - close
but not quite

# try candlestick as boxplot

# compute and merge prev close
lagdf=data.frame(SPYlag)
lagdf$date=as.Date(rownames(lagdf))
keep=c('date', 'SPY.Close')
lagdf=lagdf[keep]
names(lagdf) = c( "date","SPY.Prev")
df <- merge(df, lagdf, by.x="date", by.y="date", all=TRUE)

df$candle_lower = pmin(df$SPY.Open, df$SPY.Close)
df$candle_upper = pmax(df$SPY.Open, df$SPY.Close)
df$candle_middle = NA

df$down = df$SPY.Close> df$SPY.Prev
df$fill = ''
df$fill[df$SPY.Open < df$SPY.Close] = 'white'
df$fill[(df$fill =='') & (df$down==TRUE)] = 'red'
df$fill[df$fill ==''] = 'green'

ggplot(data=df,aes(x=date, y=SPY.Close, ymin=SPY.Low, ymax=SPY.High,
lower=candle_lower, middle=candle_middle, upper=candle_upper)) +
opts(title="S&P") + ylab("S&P") + theme_bw() +
geom_boxplot(stat='identity', aes(fill=fill, color=factor(down)))+
scale_colour_manual(values = c("#009900","red"))
+scale_fill_manual(values = c('#009900', 'red','white'))

# this is ALMOST 100%. Only problem is the whiskers are applied only
to the first candle, and I get the message 'row names were found from
a short variable and have been discarded'

Hi,

This is similar with the plot:

ggplot(data=df, aes(x=date)) + geom_linerange(aes(ymin=SPY.Low,
ymax=SPY.High)) +
geom_segment(aes(y = SPY.Open, yend = SPY.Open, xend = date - 0.5)) +
geom_segment(aes(y = SPY.Close, yend = SPY.Close, xend = date + 0.5))

messages.subject: Re: OHLC/candlestick stock prices
parts:
Thanks Kohske,

geom_segment worked better than a - glyph for geom_point.

also fixed the grouping in the boxplot so the candles look OK.

here is where it ended up. would like to have the holidays not show up
as missing candles, fix the legend/color mapping, but should be a
starting point for anyone who wants to do OHLC and candlesticks.
Pretty popular in finance, was surprised not to be able to Google for
a ggplot example.

require(quantmod)
require(ggplot2)

############################################################
# ggplot OHLC tick chart
############################################################

getSymbols(c('^GSPC'), src="yahoo")
GSPC = na.omit(GSPC)

GSPC<-GSPC['2011-09-01::']

dfSP =data.frame(GSPC)
dfSP$date=as.Date(rownames(dfSP))

# open/high/low/close
ggplot(data=dfSP, aes(x=date)) +
opts(title="S&P Index") +
ylab("S&P Index") +
theme_bw() +
geom_linerange(aes(ymin=GSPC.Low, ymax=GSPC.High)) +
geom_segment(aes(y = GSPC.Open, yend = GSPC.Open, xend = date - 0.5))
+
geom_segment(aes(y = GSPC.Close, yend = GSPC.Close, xend = date +
0.5))


############################################################
# ggplot Candlestick chart
############################################################

getSymbols(c('^GSPC'), src="yahoo")
GSPC = na.omit(GSPC)
GSPClag = lag(GSPC,1)
GSPC<-GSPC['2011-09-01::']
GSPClag<-GSPClag['2011-09-01::']

dfSP =data.frame(GSPC)
dfSP$date=as.Date(rownames(dfSP))

lagdfSP=data.frame(GSPClag)
lagdfSP$date=as.Date(rownames(lagdfSP))
keep=c('date', 'GSPC.Close')
lagdfSP=lagdfSP[keep]
names(lagdfSP) = c( "date","GSPC.Prev")
dfSP <- merge(dfSP, lagdfSP, by.x="date", by.y="date", all=TRUE)

dfSP$candle_lower = pmin(dfSP$GSPC.Open, dfSP$GSPC.Close)
dfSP$candle_upper = pmax(dfSP$GSPC.Open, dfSP$GSPC.Close)
dfSP$candle_middle = NA

dfSP$up = dfSP$GSPC.Close> dfSP$GSPC.Prev
dfSP$fill = ''
dfSP$fill[dfSP$GSPC.Close > dfSP$GSPC.Open] = 'white'
dfSP$fill[(dfSP$fill =='') & (dfSP$up==TRUE)] = 'green'
dfSP$fill[dfSP$fill ==''] = 'red'

green = "#4daf4a"
red = "#e41a1c"

ggplot(data=dfSP,aes(x=date, y=GSPC.Close, ymin=GSPC.Low,
ymax=GSPC.High,
lower=candle_lower, middle=candle_middle, upper=candle_upper)) +
opts(title="S&P Index") +
ylab("S&P Index") +
theme_bw() +
geom_boxplot(stat='identity', aes(fill=fill, color=factor(up),
group=date))+
scale_colour_manual(values = c(red,green)) +
scale_fill_manual(values = c(red, green,'white'))
